move_tensors_to_cuda: move a nested sample of tensors to a CUDA device with non-blocking transfer
move_tensors_to_cpu: move a nested sample of tensors to CPU and convert float16 to float32
clip_grad_norm: clip the gradient norm of model parameters to a specified maximum value
apply_function_to_sample: recursively apply a function to all tensors in a nested sample structure
resolve_max_positions: resolve maximum position constraints from multiple model sources by taking the minimum
